sections.heading: A love song for your submission
sections.text:
You check your submission. You check it again. The score is gorgeous, the leaderboard is glowing, and you are already imagining a future together.

But there is another board waiting behind the velvet rope.

For Friday fun day, we bring you On the Private, the full widescreen music video: a love song to a Kaggle leaderboard score, with one very nervous question at its heart. Will that lovely public result still be there for you when the unseen test data gets its turn?

sections.heading: The private board stays locked
sections.text:
The setting is a nightclub for the ARC-AGI-3 interactive AI competition, populated by competitors and their mascots. The public leaderboard shines; the private board stays locked. The video mixes AI-generated artwork and animation with lyrics and leaderboard graphics made with computer code. Mark Barney produced it for Autoresearch-Arena / VoynichLabs.

Anyone who has watched a promising score wobble on fresh data knows the fear. Repeatedly choosing submissions by their public leaderboard scores can make a team’s choices fit that visible slice too closely. A score that shines there may not hold up on the separate private test data: that is the worry behind overfitting. The singer isn’t asking for forever, just for the relationship to make it through the holdout. Until the private evaluation is revealed, the song leaves the big question unanswered.

Put on the full video, spare a thought for your favourite submission, and hope the relationship generalises.
